title: Hubble’s Expanding Universe
objective: After this level you can explain how Hubble showed that galaxies are moving apart and the universe is expanding.
summary: Hubble showed Andromeda is another galaxy, then that galaxies recede faster the farther they are: the universe is expanding.

cards.headline: In 1924, the known universe suddenly got much bigger.
One galaxy among many
cards.body: Fuzzy patches like the Andromeda “nebula” were once debated: were they clouds inside the Milky Way, or separate galaxies? In 1924 Edwin Hubble settled it. Andromeda is a separate galaxy about 2.5 million light-years away, far beyond our own.

cards.headline: Everything is moving apart
cards.body: In 1929 Hubble reported that galaxies are moving away from us, and the farther away a galaxy is, the faster it recedes. This is Hubble’s law, and it means the universe is expanding. Georges Lemaître had proposed the same idea a few years earlier.

cards.headline: No center
cards.body: The expansion has no center. Space itself is stretching, so every galaxy sees the others moving away, like raisins in rising dough that all drift apart from one another.

cards.headline: Expansion: discovered
learned: In 1924 Hubble showed Andromeda is another galaxy
Galaxies recede faster the farther they are

options.label: Galaxies are all moving toward the Milky Way
Galaxies recede faster the farther away they are
Galaxies are fixed in place and never move
Only the nearest galaxies are moving away

questions.explanation: Hubble’s law: the farther away a galaxy is, the faster it recedes, evidence that the universe is expanding.

questions.prompt: Observers in every galaxy would see the other galaxies moving away. What does this tell us?

options.label: The Milky Way is the center of the universe
options.rationale: Every galaxy would see the same thing.

options.label: Galaxies are fleeing one point in space
options.rationale: There is no single point they flee from.

options.label: Space itself is expanding, with no center
Telescopes distort the motion of galaxies

questions.explanation: Because space itself stretches, every galaxy sees the others receding. No galaxy sits at the center.

questions.prompt: From Level 10: Andromeda is about 2.5 million light-years away. Why did Hubble’s 1924 finding about it matter?

options.label: It proved galaxies exist beyond the Milky Way
It showed Andromeda is part of the Milky Way
It proved Andromeda is moving away from us
It showed that the Sun orbits Andromeda
options.rationale: The Sun orbits the Milky Way’s center.

questions.explanation: Showing that Andromeda lies far outside the Milky Way proved that our galaxy is one of many.
